tableLines.line: 📖 LEARNED: Gossip Network (Level 1). You hear things. People tell you things. You remember who told you what.
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Vito speaks at Thornfield's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
You caught the lie in his face and watched the whole table react to it before he'd finished the sentence. Face and room, both open books.
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Vito speaks at Emberhold's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Vito speaks at Stonebridge's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
You came back bloody. Nobody asks. Someone saves you the good seat by the fire.
✨ Ability gained: Harvest Table (L1). Your feasts are rituals. Every feast you host arms the feast surge even without devotion (x1.3 at least), and each guest leaves trusting you a little more.
"THE TABLE IS SET. THE VILLAGE IS ONE ANIMAL. IT IS VERY WELL FED AND IT WOULD LIKE TO HIT SOMETHING."
📓 Codex: Juan picked up Harvest Table from talking with you — what it does, and what it might go with.
📓 Codex: Owen picked up Harvest Table from talking with you — what it does, and what it might go with.

🗣️ Juan to Elijah, by the fire: "It waits. We wait. Somebody should check the snares — the table doesn't fill the pantry."

🍖 FEAST 📺 — Ruby opens the pantry wide: 10× Foraged food, 1× Foraged food. Susan, Jae-hyuk, Owen, Nikos eat until the fire burns low. The laughter stays low — somebody's seat is empty, and everybody sees it. For one evening, grief sits at the fire with them instead of standing over them. 📺 SYSTEM: ""You talk to EVERYONE and everyone talks to YOU?! You're not networking, you're COLLECTING people! The census bureau is jealous! KEEP COLLECTING!""

📡 The System, casual as a knife: "So. The pods. We could... discuss them. A favor for a peek? A peek for a promise? We LOVE a bargain. The audience LOVES a bargain. What's a little debt between friends?"
🗣️ Jae-hyuk to Owen, by the fire: "The table's set. The ring of pale light — it's just sitting there. Waiting on them. What do you think they'll tell it?"
The moment passed. Nobody mentions the pods today. A few people notice that nobody mentions them.

◈ SYSTEM: "35. You see the number. THE WORLD IS WATCHING. Broadcast tier: planetary — the audience has picked its favorite fire and it is YOURS. This is not the table. The table comes later. Tonight, the galaxy wants a show."
◈ SYSTEM: "Oh. OH. Do you feel that? That's the whole PLANET leaning in. ...There's a table, little fires. A big one. Far away. And it is LOOKING at you. Give it a season worth judging."
📡 Haven feasts for the cameras — 5,000 kcal of theater, every fire of the realm at the table. The chat eats it up. Somewhere, the table makes a note.
◈ SYSTEM: "Species agency: unlocked. You are not at the table yet. But the table has your name now."

🗣️ Rachida to Luis, by the fire: "It waits. We wait. Somebody should check the snares — the table doesn't fill the pantry."
◈ THE TABLE IS SET. A ring of pale light waits — take your seat from Haven when you are ready. Nothing is final until you sit.

◈ THE TABLE — it is not a table. It's a ring of pale light, and around it, things with too many angles to be faces. Above it all — the audience. Trillions of eyes, and every one of them knows your name. The System speaks, and for once it isn't performing: "HUMANITY PRESENTS ITS CASE."

◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (14/12/5), with 4 wave-4 fought, 6 contests survived, 2 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 2 · Forage 16 · Craft 10 · Talk 12 · Explore 28 → 24 · capped)
◈ For a full seat, the ledger still wants: only 0 of 2 different wave-5 monsters faced; only 2 of 3 crises weathered; no capstone deed delivered (military tribute, trade charter, or feast embassy).
The table notes 2 ascensions from one village — its terms improve accordingly. Nobody has ever seen that before.

◈ THE BELOVED — The audience is chanting. You don't know the words — it isn't a language with words — but you know the feeling. The table can't move against the cast's favorite. That's leverage. Tonight, the cast is your village.
The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
The terms held — the table had priced the village, ascensions and all, and the village paid in full.
You won. Say it plainly: you won. The village endures. The table signed. The galaxy applauds, and the applause is real, and you earned it.
